description:
Tell Me When checks public web pages on a schedule and emails you when a change matches a condition you set. For example, ask it to watch a course page and notify you when registration opens. The first successful check saves a baseline without sending an alert.

Ask “What happened with my watches over the past 7 days?” for a summary of recorded checks and errors. You can also request a 30-day summary or ask about one watch to see whether it’s paused, what happened at its last check, and when its next check is scheduled. Summaries and diagnostics are read-only: they don’t run a check, resume a watch, or send a notification.

You can also create, edit, pause, and resume watches from chat. A Tell Me When account and authorization are required. Check intervals depend on your plan. Monitoring is not continuous, and detection and email delivery are not guaranteed.
